children: California Attorney General Rob Bonta had spent months pressing the lawsuit he led against Paramount Skydance Corp.'s acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., but he was increasingly isolated as the deadline neared, according to Bloomberg.
The Yale-educated lawyer had talked tough on the case for months before ending up largely on his own in the fight.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Bonta Stood Alone as Paramount Deadline Approached
